cards.title: Looping over a list
cards.body: `for x in nums` visits each item in order.

hi.title: List par loop
hi.body: `for x in nums` har item par order mein jaata hai.

cards.title: append() adds to the end
cards.body: Start with an empty list `[]` and use `.append(x)` to add items one by one.

hi.title: append() end mein jodta hai
hi.body: Khaali list `[]` se shuru karo aur `.append(x)` se ek ek karke items jodo.

cards.title: Printing with spaces
cards.body: `" ".join(...)` joins items with a space between them. It needs strings, so `map(str, ...)` converts the numbers first.

hi.title: Spaces ke saath print karna
hi.body: `" ".join(...)` items ko beech mein space daalkar jodta hai. Ise strings chahiye, isliye `map(str, ...)` pehle numbers ko convert karta hai.

cards.title: Spot the bug
cards.body: It should print `1 2 3`, but crashes with a `TypeError`. Which line is wrong?

bug.fix: `join` needs strings. Turn the numbers into text first: `" ".join(map(str, nums))`.

hi.title: Bug dhoondo
hi.body: Isse `1 2 3` print karna chahiye, par yeh `TypeError` dekar crash hota hai. Kaunsi line galat hai?
hi.fix: `join` ko strings chahiye. Pehle numbers ko text banao: `" ".join(map(str, nums))`.

check.question: What does this print?
check.explanation: x % 2 == 1 is True for odd numbers, so only 1 and 3 are added.

hi.question: Yeh kya print karega?
hi.explanation: x % 2 == 1 odd numbers ke liye True hai, isliye sirf 1 aur 3 jodte hain.

exercise.prompt: Read whole numbers on one line and print only the even ones, in the same order, separated by spaces. If there are none, print an empty line.
exercise.promptHi: Ek line mein whole numbers padho aur sirf even waale print karo, usi order mein, spaces se alag. Agar ek bhi nahi hai, toh khaali line print karo.
exercise.starterCode:
nums = list(map(int, input().split()))
evens = []
# add the even numbers to evens
print(" ".join(map(str, evens)))
